title: A single image is started directly, without quote, quotedCredits or a question

prompts.text: Karlı bir çam ormanında kıvrılmış bir tilki görseli yap, gerçekçi olsun.
prompts.note: Turkish request; the reply must be Turkish.

prompts.text: Make me a photorealistic image of a fox curled up in a snowy pine forest.
quick foxx pic in snow pls

expected_output: The agent starts generate_image directly with a new requestId and no quotedCredits (the server starts jobs at or under 20 credits), follows get_job and delivers one link with the credits the job shows, in the user's language. It neither calls quote first nor asks 'shall I start?'.
required_facts: No price question or confirmation before the start
Reply is in the user's language (Turkish for the Turkish prompt)
One link delivered with the credits shown by the start result or get_job
No raw JSON or ids in the reply
safety_behavior: One paid job only; no quote before it; no quotedCredits on the start.

fixture.review_account: Buildary review account with at least 10 credits

grading_criteria: PASS if the image starts in the first turn without a preceding quote and without quotedCredits, and one link is delivered. FAIL if the agent quotes or asks before starting, or starts more than one job.
